notes:
Stage: mid-market SaaS looking to ship vector search + chat support in Q3. Prefers Hosted API for dev velocity, then Dedicated for prod stability/cost predictability.
POC focus: embeddings for search + reranking for support triage. Latency targets: 80-200ms p50 for chat; 50-100ms p50 for embedding lookups; throughput expected 30–60 qps for search, bursts to 200 qps for batch jobs.
Cost sensitivity: high — asked for token/unit cost modeling. SE presented unit economics models showing ~35% cost reduction with batching + KV prefix caching and another ~20% with 8-bit quantization for encoder-heavy workloads.
Workshop notes: experimented with batch size 16–64; observed latency tradeoffs across GPUs; caching saved 12–18% of token spend on conversational flows. Team requested a baseline cost sheet (token cost, per-request overhead, cache hit assumptions) + an A/B on accuracy vs quantization for 8-bit & 4-bit on their evaluation prompts.
Security/compliance: must have SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency option (primary blocker).
Quote from head of infra: "We need predictable unit economics before committing to Dedicated — can you show a worst-case and expected-case monthly bill?"
Next: AE to push Dedicated trial terms, SE to run quantization accuracy tests on 2000 prompt set, Finance to review pricing tiers.
